nodes.label: salary_lookup.py Benchmark Tool
nodes.rationale: Optional by design: if salary_data.json is missing the tool exits with a helpful error and /apply simply skips the benchmark step. --validate is a pre-flight check for malformed category values and duplicate company names.

nodes.label: salary_data.json Data Format
nodes.rationale: metadata (source, index_baseline, index_label, baseline_description) plus companies[] with company, optional city, and named categories carrying count and/or index. Deliberately format-agnostic so index-based, absolute-currency, or custom metrics all work. Gitignored because salary data may be proprietary.

nodes.label: Company Name Fuzzy Matcher
nodes.rationale: Handles Danish/Nordic characters, legal suffixes (A/S, ApS), anglicized spellings and partial matches, so a user typing 'Novo Nordisk' or 'Orsted' still resolves to the canonical dataset entry.

nodes.label: convert_salary_excel.py Excel-to-JSON Converter
nodes.rationale: Auto-detects the sheet layout: finds a Company/Firma column and optional City/By column, and treats remaining columns as salary data with auto-paired count/index columns.
